name: Oculus House
description: A low circular residence organized around an open rain garden. A planted concrete roof ring frames the sky and central tree, while curved bronze-framed glazing connects the living spaces to the garden. A covered gallery and a bronze rain chain make rainfall part of the architectural experience.
